2. log_transform

```{r}

img <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/ALAN/VNP46A4_t2018.tif")
alan_2018 <- img |> mask(ny_boundary)
r_df <- rasterToPoints(img, spatial = TRUE) |> as.data.frame()
names(r_df) <- c("value", "x", "y")
## Remove very low values of NTL; can be considered noise
r_df$value[r_df$value <= 2] <- 0
## Distribution is skewed, so log
r_df$value_adj <- log(r_df$value+1)
```


3. Map

```{r}
source("script/read_tree_inventory.R")
cityoi <- "NY"
df_tree <- read_tree_inventory(city = cityoi)
coordinates(df_tree) <- c("lon", "lat")
point_tree <- st_as_sf(df_tree)

betula_point <- point_tree %>% filter(str_detect(taxa, "Betula"))
bld_index <- read.csv("~/phenology-urban/result/bld_index/bld_index_betula_200.csv")
merged_data <- merge(betula_point, bld_index, by.x = "id", by.y = "tree_id", all.x = TRUE)
#plot buffer
boundary_NY <- sf::read_sf('data/raw/NY/boundary/nybb_dissolved.shp')
merged_data <- st_set_crs(merged_data, "EPSG:4326")


##### Map
p <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = r_df,  aes(x = x, y = y,  fill = value_adj)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "black",
                       mid = "yellow",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 4.5) +
  labs(title = "Nighttime Lights: 2018") +
  coord_quickmap() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none")


p <- p + geom_sf(data = merged_data, color = "red", size = 0.02)
p
ggsave("~/phenology-urban/result/alan/alan_2018_betula.jpg", p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")


```

4. Relationship

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)
library(future)
library(foreign)
library(raster)
library(sf)

## ALAN data for tree
extracted_values <- extract(img, betula_point)
betula_point$alan <- extracted_values
## Remove very low values of NTL; can be considered noise
betula_point$alan[betula_point$alan_adj <= 2] <- 0
## Distribution is skewed, so log
betula_point$alan_adj <- log(betula_point$alan+1)
hist(betula_point$alan_adj, main = "Histogram of log (Artificial Light at Night) for Betula")


doy_NY_Betula <- readRDS("~/phenology-batchplanet/alldata/PSdata/urban/doy/doy_NY_Betula.rds")

down_doy <- doy_NY_Betula %>%
  filter(year == 2018, direction == "down", thres == 0.5) %>%
  select(id, down_05_2018 = doy)
up_doy <- doy_NY_Betula %>%
  filter(year == 2018, direction == "up", thres == 0.5) %>%
  select(id, up_05_2018 = doy)
doy_NY_Betula <- down_doy %>%
  left_join(up_doy, by = "id")

bld_index <- read.csv("~/phenology-urban/result/bld_index/bld_index_betula_200.csv")
betula_200_bld_forstats <- left_join(doy_NY_Betula, bld_index, by = c("id" = "tree_id"))

betula_200_bld_forstats <- left_join(betula_200_bld_forstats, betula_point, by = c("id" = "id"))

saveRDS(betula_200_bld_forstats, "~/phenology-urban/result/betula_200_bld_forstats_alan.rds")

source("~/phenology-urban/script/plot_linear.R")
plot <- plot_function(betula_200_bld_forstats$alan_adj, betula_200_bld_forstats$BHD_betula_200, 
                    "alan_adj", "bcr")
plot
```
